methodology: Buy/Hold/Sell calls from FinSight's real production decision path (report_data_builder.derive_recommendation), scored 12 months later against the same +-5%% rule validated in EVALUATION.md. Pooled across two non-overlapping historical windows on the broad 1,002-ticker S&P 500+400+600(partial) universe -- not a hand-picked ticker list.
live_tracker_note: The live production call tracker (app/api/db.py tracked_call_checkpoints, window_days=365) is not pooled in yet -- this deploy target's filesystem is ephemeral across redeploys, so it has no data that has reliably survived to maturity. See this script's module docstring.
summary_line: 36.4% forward-accuracy (N=923, 95% CI 33.4-39.6%) vs. 60.0% Always-Buy baseline (95% CI 56.8-63.1%)
